**Statistics for Product Teams**

Make better product decisions with data you can trust. Statistics for Product Teams is a practical six-week online course designed for product managers, designers, engineers, and analysts who want to move beyond gut instinct and dashboards without a statistics degree.

Taught by Dr. Helen Okafor, the course focuses on the concepts teams actually use: framing testable hypotheses, designing and running A/B tests, interpreting confidence intervals and p-values, avoiding common pitfalls like peeking and underpowered experiments, and communicating uncertainty to stakeholders. Each week combines concise lessons with real-world case studies and hands-on exercises you can apply to your own product immediately.

By the end, you'll be able to evaluate experiment results critically, ask sharper questions of your data, and make confident, defensible recommendations.

**Start date:** September 8
**Format:** 6 weeks, online
**Price:** $480

Enroll today and bring statistical clarity to your team's next decision.
